summary: Implement the frozen provider-neutral bidirectional sync engine with versioned direction/source-of-truth policies, durable checkpoints/replay receipts, Connector SDK identity mappings, deterministic idempotency, correlation/causation and policy-scoped loop/conflict controls.

impacts.evidence: Policies, checkpoints, entity state and both receipt ledgers are explicitly organization/workspace scoped, use forced RLS and require tenant-qualified connector-account identity.
Durable sync evidence stores bounded identifiers, revisions and SHA-256 fingerprints only; raw provider errors, credentials and provider payload bodies are not persisted by Task 013.
Task 013 adds no public HTTP operation. Sync orchestration remains an internal platform capability for later connector/application adapters.

The engine preserves correlation/causation and derives deterministic local event/idempotency identifiers but introduces no new EventBus event schema; domain adapters continue to emit their existing versioned events.
Connector SDK root interfaces remain unchanged. Task 013 consumes the existing MappingRepository and defines host-side remote/local adapter ports outside the frozen provider SDK root.
Expand migration 000024 adds five forced-RLS sync tables, tenant-qualified connector-account FK, optimistic state/checkpoint versions and immutable replay receipts.
No provider credentials or raw remote error text cross the sync persistence contract; idempotency/collision checks fail closed and source-of-truth cannot bypass tenant/mapping validation.
Task 013 only orchestrates propagation. Sensitive domain writes remain responsible for Task-017 approval/risk enforcement in their local adapters and connector host path.

Correlation, causation, stable event/change ids and canonical payload fingerprints are preserved so existing domain audit/outbox/lineage evidence can be connected across propagation without a second audit source of truth.

This is the primary impact: page checkpoints, append-only inbound/outbound receipts, deterministic side-effect keys, mapping identity, local/remote version state, echo suppression and conflict tests establish the Task-014 reconciliation substrate.
Task 013 does not use durable webhook egress. Remote writes occur only through a host-supplied connector adapter boundary with deterministic idempotency metadata.
Pull page size is bounded to 1000 and result outcomes are bounded machine states. Production lag/drift/error SLOs remain owned by later reconciliation/SLO tasks.
Disable sync policies to stop propagation. Migration 000024 is expand-only; immutable receipts/state are retained rather than destructively rolled back.

Tests cover inbound/outbound direction, crash before state/checkpoint commit, idempotent replay, explicit/fingerprint loop suppression, cross-policy propagation, receipt collision and local/remote/manual conflict behavior.
